text: Rachel - new job @ Lloyds from Mon. ask how 1st wk went, maybe Fri afternoon
Lucy + Reza engaged!! proposed in Lisbon last wkend. send congrats card
Felix leaving drinks Thurs @ 6 @ the Crown. 12 yrs at the firm, retiring end of month
Claire's 10th anniv w/ her husband Sat. she wants to do something low key - dinner @ home prob
Efua starts as deputy head after half term. nervous abt it tbh. text her good luck the night before
call Julien re: Sunday lunch - his mum coming too

Ava - wedding called off. her + Finn split up last month, she's moved back to her mum's for now. bit raw still, keeps saying she's fine but clearly not. don't mention it to her sister, she'll tell her herself. lunch w/ her Sat - my treat, somewhere quiet. maybe walk after. check in again the wk after
Camila promoted to team lead!! drinks Friday at 7. get her a bottle of something nice
Aditi interview w/ Deloitte tomorrow morning @ 9. she's super anxious. message her that morning

Olivia's parents 40th wedding anniv - party 14th Nov @ the golf club, 7pm. Liv organising the whole thing + her brother's useless. stressed out, venue wants final numbers by the 1st. offered to do the photo slideshow - need old pics from her by next wkend. ring her the day before to see if she needs a hand setting up
dentist Weds 8.30am. then pick up dry cleaning
Ana / dog Biscuit had op yday, recovering ok. pop round w/ treats sat morning
Hassan - first day @ BT was today. said it went fine, bit overwhelming. check in next wk
Akira + Mia got married @ registry office, small do. reception in spring for everyone else

Dimitri Petrov (Dim) retiring Dec after 30 yrs on the buses. leaving do the Friday after at the depot social club, 8ish. wife Agnieszka says he's v emotional abt it, doesn't know what to do w/ himself. they're off to Crete in Jan to celebrate. collection going round - put in £20. Dim into fishing, so a new reel wd go down well
Naledi engaged to Kieran - wedding in Cape Town next Aug. save the date coming
Ben's brother Yusuf starts uni next wk. Ben driving him down Sat, back Sun night
Mateo hates his new manager. thinking abt quitting
remind me to ask Agnieszka how the job offer convo went w/ her boss
Darius + wife Isla anniv 15th - 5 yrs. he wants ideas. she likes pottery, mentioned a class voucher
Jamal - redundancy meeting Mon @ 2pm. really worried. ring him Mon evening afterwards
Adebayo (Ade) - his sister getting married in June, he's doing the speech. terrified. offered to listen to a draft - he'll send it over the wk before
Yusuf vegan now. allergic to cashews too - for the bbq

Kieran's last day @ Tesco Fri - 9 yrs!! cake in the staff room at 3. new job at Ocado starts the Mon after, ops manager. he's excited but worried abt the shifts w/ the kids. his partner Isla back at work too from Nov. ask how it went the wk after - maybe Thurs evening, he's free after 7
Sophie + Tomás - housewarming Sat at 8. bring wine. they moved to Leith
Finn's grandad passed away Tues. funeral next Thurs morning. send flowers the day before
Reza - started freelancing, loves it. works from cafes mostly
Lucy's mum retiring after 25 yrs nursing. party at hers 3rd at half 7. chip in for gift - Claire collecting
must post Felix's card by Weds - his bday Sat
coffee w/ Rachel Thurs 11am @ Monmouth. she wants to chat abt career change
Efua - wedding dress fitting the 12th at half 9. her mum going with her
Mustafa - got the promotion to senior eng!! starts new role 1st Dec. congrats msg
Julien + Camila 1st anniv Weds. they're doing a weekend in Paris after
need to book car MOT before the 20th. garage closes 5pm
Claire Walsh - new job @ council, planning dept. starts 2 wks Mon. kind of dreading the commute
Ava's dad retiring Fri. she's taking him out for lunch the day after
Aditi - didn't get the Deloitte job. gutted. FaceTime her this wkend, cheer her up
Hassan + his partner expecting!! due March. haven't told work yet

Akira - leaving the band, moving to Osaka for a job @ Sony in Jan. farewell gig Sat 30th at 9pm @ the Windmill. whole crew going. Mia's making a photo book from the tour, chipping in for printing. need to sort a lift home after - last train's at 11.40. see him for a proper goodbye coffee the wk after before he flies
Olivia's engagement party - off. postponed till they sort the venue. sticking w/ Sunday brunch instead w/ her
Ana - wedding anniv Tues. Ana keeps hinting abt a new coffee machine for the kitchen - tell Mateo
Dimitri - knee surgery 4th Nov, early morning. off work 6 wks after. visit the wk after
Naledi Kaur cat Pepper ran off Sun, came back Tues. v relieved
Ben - stag do in Prague 7-9th. need to sort flights by Fri evening
Mateo's sister Ana got engaged at Xmas, wedding next summer in Valencia

Jamal starts the new job at Arup on Mon at 8am. bit nervous - first proper eng role since the redundancy. text good luck Sun night + ask how 1st day went the next day. he mentioned his mum's cooking a big dinner Mon evening to celebrate, so not that night. also lend him my laptop bag before
picked up Isla's parcel for her, she's back from Spain Thurs. drop it round Thurs evening
Adebayo + Efua celebrating 20 yrs married next month. their kids throwing surprise party - shh. Sat 22nd at 7
Yusuf - got into the Arsenal ladies coaching course. starts Jan
Kieran Brennan - interview Tues 3pm for the head chef job @ Dishoom. remind me to ask Wed morning how it went
cancel gym membership. renew passport b4 Easter

Sophie's aunt's 60th - big do in Galway Fri 6th, flying out Thurs morning, back Sun. Sophie dreading the speech, her cousins roped her in. she's also got her own work review the Mon after so a lot on. said I'd read the speech Weds at lunch. message her Fri afternoon before it starts
Tomás - Tom - shift change, nights from Nov. tired all the time already. check in on him

Finn and Rachel's wedding - Sat 18th @ 2pm, church then barn in the Cotswolds. I'm doing the readings. suit fitting Weds after work. hotel booked Fri + Sat night. they've asked for no gifts but honeymoon fund - Bali. Rachel's gran flying in from Dublin the Thurs before, she's 92. bring a card + get some cash out the day before
Mia Zhou - new job at the Guardian, sub-editing. loving it so far
Lucy's boss Sophie leaving. Lucy might apply for her role, interview prob Jan
Reza + Felix moving in together 1st Dec. need help w/ van that morning - I said yes. ask Camila if she can come too

long call w/ Claire. her and Julien having a hard time, couples counselling Thurs evenings now. she's coping but exhausted. her mum not well either, scan next Tues. don't push abt the wedding plans, just listen. ring her Weds before the scan, then the day after to see how it went
Hassan's mum turning 70 on the 28th. family dinner @ Zaap Sat after at 6pm. Hassan says she wants a nice scarf
Darius - offered partner at the firm!! announcement Mon. took him for a drink to celebrate. he said Isla's planning a dinner the wkend after - she'll ping me details
